# synology_rsync (Resource)

Rsync network-backup service policy. Account credentials and custom configuration remain outside this resource. Destroy leaves DSM settings unchanged.

## Adopt existing settings

1. Add the import block below with your resource address and the ID of the existing DSM object.
2. Set your arguments to the values DSM currently reports. The sample configuration shows the shape and uses example values.
3. Run `terraform plan`. For one import, apply only when it reports `1 to import, 0 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy`.

```terraform
import {
  to = synology_rsync.main
  id = "rsync"
}
```

## Example configuration

```terraform
resource "synology_rsync" "main" {
  enabled          = false
  accounts_enabled = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `accounts_enabled` (Boolean) Enable rsync-specific accounts. This does not create or rotate account credentials.
- `custom_configuration_enabled` (Boolean) Enable the existing custom rsync configuration. This resource does not edit its text.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable the rsync network-backup service.
- `ssh_port` (Number) Rsync SSH port, from 1 to 65535.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Singleton identity and import identifier: rsync. Destroy only releases Terraform management; it never resets DSM settings.
